name: Cross-platform attention confirmation
hypothesis: Buy a breakout only after separately timestamped attention rises on multiple permitted data sources and chain demand follows.
spec: Setup: Independent communities may create broader participation than one promoted feed. Entry: Buy a breakout only after separately timestamped attention rises on multiple permitted data sources and chain demand follows. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on price failure or disappearance of purchase conversion. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs a social / announcement feed with receipt times (not connected)
